2014_spells.shield.description: An invisible barrier of magical force appears and protects you. Until the start of your next turn, you have a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack, and you take no damage from magic missile.
2014_spells.shield.effectSummary: Make a creature invisible until it attacks or the spell ends
